title: Normal-Anchored First-Order Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning based Whisper Fine-Tuning for Enhancing Fairness of Cleft Lip and Palate Speech Recognition
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving automatic speech recognition (ASR) performance and enhancing fairness for individuals with a physical speech disability (cleft lip and palate). It does not discuss, evaluate, or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, theology, moral reasoning, or ethics.
